lines.text: Patch 12.1 Curse of Ula'tek is now official for Aug 11, with Season 2 and the Venomous Abyss raid opening Aug 18
Pokopia's free Dive update and the Bubbly Basin DLC are now dated: both land Aug 5
GO Fest 2026: Mega Finale set for Sep 5-6, Pokopia's Feebas event runs Aug 13-28, and the LEGO Stores tie-in runs Aug 3 - Sep 30
Ultra Unlock 10th Anniversary, Rillaboom Max Battle Day, and July's Trading Post have wrapped

needs_you.action: Claim GO Pass: July rewards by 10am local (rank earning already ends Aug 4 at 10am)
Finish Summer Marathon's free Timed Research before it expires at 8pm local
Finish the Turbulent Timeways meta before the event ends Aug 11 to secure the Spawn of Vyranoth mount
Spend your double-rate Illusionary Coins on Decor Duels rewards before 12.1 removes the event on Aug 11
Close out Season 1 goals (raid Feats, Keystone Master, PvP and Delve rewards) before the season ends at the Aug 11 reset
Claim Summer Marathon event pass rewards before they expire at 8pm local
Evolve Nickit by 9pm local on Community Day to get Thievul with Icy Wind
Buy the $4.99 Starmie Super Mega Raid Day ticket before it leaves the shop at 5pm local on event day
Claim Water Festival event pass rewards by 8pm local
Finish the August Traveler's Log for the Ensemble: Midnight Outlaw and spend or freeze Tender before the Sep 1 rollover

games.typical_lead_time: in-game calendar visible 4+ weeks out; shop and patch news 1-2 weeks

timeline.title: Turbulent Timeways V
timeline.detail: The finale week (Dragonflight Timewalking) runs Aug 4-11; finish the six-week meta before the event ends Aug 11 to claim the Spawn of Vyranoth mount.

timeline.title: Trading Post: Showdown
timeline.detail: August's black-and-white western rotation offers the Hateforged Blazecycle (500 Tender), Badlands Buzzard (550), and Grandmaster's Royal Board (700), with the Ensemble: Midnight Outlaw as the Traveler's Log bonus reward.

timeline.title: Decor Duels: Final Surge
timeline.detail: Play Decor Duels in Silvermoon City for double Illusionary Coins and spend them before Curse of Ula'tek removes the mode Aug 11; decor moves to Voidlight Marl vendors afterward.

timeline.title: Last chance: Midnight Season 1
timeline.detail: Season 1 ends when Curse of Ula'tek launches Aug 11: Blizzard's last call covers the raid Feats, Keystone Master and Mythic+ rewards, PvP elite transmog, and Delve rewards that disappear with it.

timeline.title: Darkmoon Faire
timeline.detail: Visit Darkmoon Island through Aug 8 for tickets, profession quests, and the monthly carousel and top-hat buffs.

timeline.title: Trial of Style
timeline.detail: Queue for the transmog contest scenario through Aug 8 to earn Trial of Style tokens for exclusive ensembles.

timeline.title: Catch the Drift subscription promo
timeline.detail: Buy or hold a 6 or 12 month recurring subscription to receive the Sunflare Driftmoth skyriding mount and Sunflutter Driftmoth pet.

timeline.title: WoW BlizzCon 2026 Bundle
timeline.detail: Buy the bundle (Rabbit'ath Void mount, Garb of the Dawnfire Phoenix ensemble, Perch of the Dawnfire Phoenix housing decor) on the Battle.net Shop by Sep 28.

timeline.title: Patch 12.1: Curse of Ula'tek
timeline.detail: The content update opens the Coiled Isle with the Altar of Fangs dungeon, Lairs (instanced world bosses starting with the Tidebound Grotto), new Delves, Prey hunts, and housing updates; Heroic and Mythic 0 dungeons unlock at launch.

timeline.title: Free T-Shirt Day (micro-holiday)
timeline.detail: Visit the vendor NPCs across Azeroth during this one-day micro-holiday to collect the free shirt cosmetics.

timeline.title: Midnight Season 2 and the Venomous Abyss
timeline.detail: The eight-boss Venomous Abyss raid opens Aug 18 on Normal, Heroic, Mythic, and Raid Finder Wing 1 alongside Mythic+, PvP, and Delve Season 2; Story Mode and Wing 2 follow Aug 25, Wing 3 Sep 1, Wing 4 Sep 8.

timeline.title: Northrend Cup
timeline.detail: Fly Northrend skyriding race courses in Normal, Advanced, and Reverse modes for Riders of Azeroth Badges and cosmetics.

weekly_rhythm: Week of Jul 28 (now): Burning Crusade Timewalking (TT week 5) and the Arena Skirmish Bonus Event run until reset Aug 4; PvP Brawl: Gravity Lapse; Darkmoon Faire and Trial of Style through Aug 8
Week of Aug 4: Dragonflight Timewalking, the Turbulent Timeways finale, ends Aug 11; PvP Brawl: Deepwind Dunk
Week of Aug 11: Patch 12.1 launches at the reset; World Quest Bonus Event; PvP Brawl: Shado-Pan Showdown; Free T-Shirt Day Aug 16
Week of Aug 18: Season 2, Mythic+, PvP, and the Venomous Abyss raid open; Battleground Bonus Event; PvP Brawl: Warsong Scramble
Week of Aug 25: Pet Battle Bonus Event and Northrend Timewalking; PvP Brawl: Cooking Impossible; Northrend Cup begins Aug 25; raid Story Mode and Raid Finder Wing 2 open
Week of Sep 1: Delves Bonus Event; PvP Brawl: Temple of Hotmogu; Raid Finder Wing 3; Darkmoon Faire returns Sep 5 (estimated from first-Saturday cadence)
just_past_window: Sep 8-15: Midnight Dungeon Event; PvP Brawl: Southshore vs Tarren Mill; Venomous Abyss Raid Finder Wing 4 opens
Sep 15-22: Cataclysm Timewalking; PvP Brawl: Classic Ashran
Sep 19-20: Pirates' Day, with Brewfest starting Sep 20 (through Oct 6)

games.typical_lead_time: events usually announced 1-4 weeks ahead; season schedule posted at season start

timeline.title: Choose Your Path: Fairy Trail
timeline.detail: Finish whichever locked path you picked (Explore, Catch, or Battle) and claim its Timed Research before it expires today at 8pm local.

timeline.title: GO Pass: July
timeline.detail: Rank earning ends Aug 4 at 10am local (Ho-Oh at rank 100, anniversary-coin Gimmighoul at ranks 101 and 200); claim everything by Aug 6 at 10am before rewards expire.

timeline.title: LEGO Stores and Pokemon GO
timeline.detail: Participating US LEGO Stores host boosted Pikachu raids, a stamp rally with Special Background Pikachu encounters, and a SMART Play demo with a collectible tag; start the rally by Sep 30 at 11:59pm local.

timeline.title: GO Pass: August
timeline.detail: Rank toward Latias encounters (Shiny possible) with the Lucky Trinket as the final Deluxe reward; Deluxe $7.99 or $9.99 with 10 ranks, rank earning ends Sep 8 at 10am local, claim by Sep 10 at 10am, and use the Trinket by Sep 13.

timeline.title: Summer Marathon: Arctic Embers
timeline.detail: Shiny Snom debuts via GO Pass tasks and Eggs, with boosted-shiny Ponyta, Slugma, Snover, and Vanillite alternating daily; free Timed Research expires Aug 10 at 8pm local and event pass rewards by Aug 12 at 8pm.

timeline.title: Fire and Ice Hatch Day
timeline.detail: Hatch Smoochum and Magby from 2km Eggs at half hatch distance with boosted shiny odds and 2x hatch Candy; Larvesta possible from 5km Eggs, and the free Timed Research Incubator must be claimed by 5pm local.

timeline.title: Choose Your Path: Venom and Vines
timeline.detail: Pick your Explore, Catch, or Battle path again for a week of tailored Timed Research; claim everything before Aug 17 at 8pm local.

timeline.title: Nickit Community Day
timeline.detail: Catch Shiny-boosted Nickit with 3x catch Stardust and 2x Candy, and evolve it by 9pm local for Thievul with Icy Wind; optional $1.99 Special Research adds Special Background encounters, trade bonuses run 2-9pm.

timeline.title: Ultra Unlock: Water Festival
timeline.detail: Arrokuda, Barraskewda, and Cramorant debut alongside Shiny Ducklett and Dewpider boosts; catch bonuses climb to 4x XP and 5x Stardust by Aug 22-24, and event pass rewards expire Aug 26 at 8pm local.

timeline.title: Starmie Super Mega Raid Day
timeline.detail: Mega Starmie debuts in Super Mega Raids with boosted shiny odds and up to 6 free Raid Passes from Gym spins; the optional $4.99 ticket (in shop until 5pm local) raises that to 14 plus guaranteed Rare Candy XL per catch.

timeline.title: Pokemon XP and 2026 Worlds
timeline.detail: Worlds-themed event runs Aug 25 at 10am to Aug 30 at 8pm local; full details not yet announced, check back before it starts.

timeline.title: GO Fest 2026: Mega Finale
timeline.detail: The summer-ending global GO Fest event runs Sep 5-6 with details still to come; GO Pass: August points are uncapped that same weekend.

weekly_rhythm: Spotlight Hour is Thursdays 6-7pm local this season; Raid Hour is Wednesdays 6-7pm local; Max Monday runs 6am-9pm local
Thu Aug 6: Spotlight Hour, Delibird, 2x catch Stardust
Thu Aug 13: Spotlight Hour, Wurmple, 2x evolution XP
Thu Aug 20: Spotlight Hour, Magikarp, 2x catch XP
Thu Aug 27: Spotlight Hour, Mankey, 2x catch Candy (September lineup not yet posted)
Max Mondays: Aug 3 Magmar, Aug 10 Beldum, Aug 17 Magikarp, Aug 24 Hitmontop, Aug 31 Eevee (all Dynamax)

5-star raids: Kyurem through Aug 4; Uxie, Mesprit, and Azelf Aug 5-11 (Azelf in the Americas, all three in the Aug 5 Raid Hour); Groudon Aug 12-18; Lunala Aug 19-25; Regirock, Regice, and Registeel Aug 26 - Sep 8 (Raid Hours Aug 26 and Sep 2)
Shadow Raids (weekends): Shadow Palkia through Aug 4, then Shadow Giratina (Altered) Aug 5 - Sep 8
Mega Raids: Aggron through Aug 4, Blaziken Aug 5-11, Garchomp Aug 12-18, Swampert Aug 19-25, Gyarados Aug 26 - Sep 8

GO Battle League (flips Tuesdays 1pm PDT): Great League + Master Premier through Aug 4, Ultra League + Weather Cup Aug 4-11, Master League + Evolution Cup Aug 11-18, Great League + Scroll Cup Aug 18-25, GL/UL/ML Aug 25 - Sep 1, GL/UL/ML Mega Edition Sep 1-8
just_past_window: Sep 8, 10am local: the Forever Forward season and GO Pass: August rank earning both end; a new season begins
Sep 10, 10am local: GO Pass: August rewards expire; use the Deluxe Lucky Trinket by Sep 13 at 11:59pm
Nov 14-15: Pokemon GO Wild Area: Global returns (tickets on sale next season)

games.typical_lead_time: in-game events announced only 4-7 days ahead; DLC and update news months ahead

timeline.title: Mystery Gift: Chansey Plant
timeline.detail: Enter code P0K0P1AGARDENS at any Pokemon Center PC (Mystery Gift, Get with Code/Password) for a placeable Chansey Plant; codes are region free, valid through Oct 7.

timeline.title: Mystery Gift: Ditto Rug
timeline.detail: Claim the Ditto Rug at any Pokemon Center PC via the Get via Internet option, no code needed; available through Jan 31, 2027.

timeline.title: Expansion Pass
timeline.detail: The three-part Expansion Pass is on the eShop and includes a dynamic Ditto print recipe plus a 30 rare Pokemetal ingots code if bought by Aug 31, 2027 (code valid through Sep 30, 2027).

timeline.title: Free update: Dive
timeline.detail: The free Aug 5 update lets all players learn Dive to explore, build, and plant underwater; requires the Bleak Beach environment request, jump, and Surf.

timeline.title: Expansion Pass Part 1: Bubbly Basin
timeline.detail: Part 1 releases Aug 5 and adds the underwater town of Bubbly Basin with new furniture, outfits, and sea Pokemon; requires Dive, with Part 2 following in late 2026 and Part 3 in 2027.

timeline.title: Fetching Scales for Feebas
timeline.detail: Feebas visits town asking for help collecting Prism Scales to exchange for event items, including habitat pieces for Feebas and Milotic.

games.typical_lead_time: official news posts land 1-2 weeks ahead; global launch is tracked for Q3 2026

timeline.title: Global launch
timeline.detail: Aniimo launches free-to-play on PS5, Xbox Series X|S, Steam, Epic, iOS, and Android; pre-register on any platform for milestone rewards, and beta players who sealed a Bond Pact Aniimo reclaim it by logging in at launch.
timeline.estimate_basis: Publisher-confirmed Q3 2026 window; no launch date announced as of Aug 3
